name: @pipeworx/mcp-pubtator

tools.name: pubtator_find_entity
tools.description: Resolve a gene, disease, chemical/drug, variant, species or cell-line name to its normalized PubTator 3 entity id (e.g. "BRCA1" -> @GENE_BRCA1, NCBI Gene 672; "breast cancer" -> @DISEASE_Breast_Neoplasms, MeSH D001943). Use the id with pubtator_search and pubtator_relations. Sourced from the PubTator 3 autocomplete index at NCBI/NLM, which normalizes to NCBI Gene, MeSH, LitVar/dbSNP and NCBI Taxonomy. Keyless.

query.description: Name or synonym to look up, e.g. "BRCA1", "metformin", "breast cancer", "V600E".

concept.description: Restrict to one entity type. Omit to search all six. gene, disease, chemical and variant are densely covered; species and cellline autocomplete is sparse.

tools.name: pubtator_search
tools.description: Search PubMed/PMC literature by biomedical entity and get back, for each paper, the sentence that matched with its entity mentions decoded (gene, disease, chemical, variant, species, cell line — each normalized to an id). Query by plain text ("metformin alzheimer"), by PubTator entity ids combined with AND/OR ("@GENE_BRCA1 AND @DISEASE_Breast_Neoplasms"), or by a relation ("relations:treat|@CHEMICAL_Doxorubicin|@DISEASE_Breast_Neoplasms"). 10 results per page; total count and page count returned. Sourced from the PubTator 3 search index at NCBI/NLM (~36M PubMed abstracts + PMC open-access full text). Keyless.

query.description: Free text, or PubTator entity ids joined with AND / OR (e.g. "@GENE_BRCA1 AND @DISEASE_Breast_Neoplasms"), or a relation query "relations:<type>|<entity1>|<entity2>". Get ids from pubtator_find_entity.

tools.name: pubtator_relations
tools.description: List the relations PubTator 3 has extracted for a gene, disease, chemical or variant — which drugs treat a disease, which genes a disease is associated with, which chemicals inhibit a gene — ranked by supporting-publication count, each labelled machine-extracted, and the top relations carrying their supporting passages (the actual sentences, with PMIDs). Filter by relation type (treat, cause, associate, interact, inhibit, stimulate, prevent, positive/negative_correlate, cotreat, drug_interact, compare) and/or by a second entity. Accepts a PubTator id (@GENE_BRCA1) or a plain name. Sourced from the PubTator 3 relation-extraction model at NCBI/NLM — predictions from text, not curated. Keyless.

entity.description: The entity to list relations for: a PubTator id ("@GENE_BRCA1", "@CHEMICAL_Doxorubicin") or a plain name ("BRCA1", "doxorubicin") — a name is resolved via autocomplete and reported in resolved_from.

type.description: Restrict to one relation type. Omit for all types.

target.description: Optional second entity to restrict to (id or plain name), e.g. "@DISEASE_Breast_Neoplasms".

evidence_for.description: How many of the top relations get supporting passages attached (one search each), 0-5 (default 3). Each attaches up to 3 passages with PMIDs.

tools.name: pubtator_relation_evidence
tools.description: The supporting passages behind one specific PubTator 3 relation — every paper whose text the model read the relation from, with the matched sentence, both entities' mentions, PMID, journal and date. Give the relation type and both entities (ids or plain names); page through the results 10 at a time. Use after pubtator_relations to audit a predicted relation. Sourced from the PubTator 3 search index at NCBI/NLM; the relation itself is machine-extracted, not curated. Keyless.

entity1.description: First entity — PubTator id or plain name, e.g. "@CHEMICAL_Doxorubicin".

entity2.description: Second entity — PubTator id or plain name, e.g. "@DISEASE_Breast_Neoplasms". Order does not matter.

tools.name: pubtator_annotations
tools.description: Entity annotations for specific PubMed articles: every gene, disease, chemical, variant, species and cell-line mention in the title and abstract (or PMC full text), each normalized to NCBI Gene / MeSH / dbSNP / Taxonomy ids with its character offsets, plus any relations PubTator 3 extracted within the article. Up to 20 PMIDs per call. Sourced from the PubTator 3 BioC JSON export at NCBI/NLM; all annotations are machine-extracted. Keyless.

full_text.description: Return PMC open-access full-text passages when available (default false: title + abstract only). Full text can be 100+ passages; each passage is truncated to 1,500 characters.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-pubtator forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the pubtator pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
